title: HR
subtitle: Employees and people cost by period

lock.title: HR is a Pro plan feature
lock.body: Register employees, track people cost by period and keep everything with history and audit.

aviso: The data in this record (tax ID, bank details and pay) is processed only for people management and company cost. Access is restricted to users with the HR permission and is logged. Do not record health data (medical certificates, ICD codes).

colab.vazioDesc: Add the first person to start calculating the monthly cost.
colab.pendencias: {count, plural, one {# employee has no allocation} other {# employees have no allocation}}: {nomes}. Their cost appears in the P&L as "Unallocated" until resolved.

form.salarioHint: Effective from the start date. Change it later under Pay.
form.revelaNota: Viewing the CPF and bank details is recorded in the access log.
form.usuarioHint: Optional. Gives this person the "my indicators" view (needs the "HR — my indicators" permission).

ph.pix: Tax ID, e-mail, phone or random key

rem.nota: Changes apply from the given date and never alter closed periods.

custo.confirmarFechar: Close {comp}? Each employee's cost is frozen and no later change affects this month.
custo.vazioTitulo: No active employees in this period
custo.vazioDesc: Add employees and salaries to see the monthly cost.
custo.premissas: Charges and accruals (13th salary and vacation + 1/3) apply only to CLT contracts. Salary and benefits are prorated by active days in the month. The charges base is salary + accruals + commission + bonus; benefits are excluded.
custo.rateioNota: Posted automatically to each center's actuals, in the period. Anything without an allocation shows as "Unallocated" in the P&L.

encargos.desc: A single company-wide rate applied to all CLT employees. It varies with the tax regime — confirm with your accountant.

log.titulo: Who accessed or changed employee data

comum.erroCarregar: Could not load. Please try again.

alocacao.nota: Split the employee across cost centers by percentage; the total must be 100%. The monthly cost goes to each center's actuals, in the right period.

centro.orcamentoHint: Applies to the current month; adjust other months in the Cost centers module.
centro.jaExiste: A center with a name equal or similar to "{nome}" already exists. Use the existing one?

sugeridos.desc: You don't have cost centers yet. Tick the ones that fit your company; nothing is created without your confirmation.

resumo.nota: Sale period. Reversals from already-closed months come back as a negative adjustment in the period of the reversal date. The total goes into the employee's monthly cost.
resumo.semCusto: {count, plural, one {# sale was left out of the margin base for lack of product cost} other {# sales were left out of the margin base for lack of product cost}}. Add the cost in Reports → Sales.

vendas.nota: Assign each sale to whoever sold it (you can split it). Only assigned sales earn commission. Margin = revenue − product cost − taxes − card fee − marketplace fee − other costs.
vendas.truncado: Showing the first 500 sales of the month.

atribuicao.nota: Split the sale among one or more commissioned people; the total must be 100%.
atribuicao.semComissionados: No commissioned employees. Tick "Commissioned?" under Employees → Edit.

estorno.nota: If the sale's month is still open, its commission is recalculated. If it's already closed, the amount comes back as a negative adjustment in the period of the reversal date.

regras.nota: Applies to the period according to its validity. A rule for a specific employee beats the general rule. Changes affect open periods only.
regras.faixasNota: Set the monthly amount from which each percentage applies. The first tier starts at 0.

modosHint.marginal: each tier covers only the part inside it
modosHint.total: the reached tier's % applies to the whole amount

regras.efeito: Closed periods don't change: closing freezes the commission.

premissas.nota: Estimates as % of revenue, used only by margin-based rules. The marketplace fee comes real, from the order entry.

retorno.semCusto: {count, plural, one {# sale} other {# sales}} without product cost left out of the margin. Add the cost in Reports → Sales.
retorno.vazioTitulo: No assigned sales in the period
retorno.vazioDesc: Assign sales to sellers in HR → Commissions to see each person's return.

mix.nota: % of assigned revenue in each sale-margin band.

definicoes.receita: Assigned revenue: value of the sales assigned to the person (by their share), net of reversals.
definicoes.margem: Gross margin: revenue − product cost − taxes − card fee − marketplace fee − other costs (assumptions in HR → Commissions).
definicoes.comissao: Commission: the amount calculated in the period's months, including reversal adjustments.
definicoes.contribuicao: Contribution margin = gross margin − commission. This is the main indicator.
definicoes.custo: Allocated cost: salary, charges, accruals, benefits and bonus for the period, excluding commission (already taken out of the contribution).
definicoes.resultado: Assigned net result = contribution − allocated cost. Supplementary.
definicoes.desconto: Discounts: difference between the current list price in Inventory and the amount charged, for sales with a registered SKU.
definicoes.filtros: Filters: the cost-center filter limits people and allocated cost to that center (sales have no center). With a product filter, commission is estimated from the month's effective % and people cost is not shown.
definicoes.proprio: You only see your own sales indicators, without people costs.

folha.aviso: Calculations must be reviewed by the responsible accountant.

mes.dsrNota: Used for weekly rest pay on overtime and night shift premium.
mes.foraDaFolha: {count, plural, one {# non-CLT person is outside payroll (contractors, interns and others are paid separately)} other {# non-CLT people are outside payroll (contractors, interns and others are paid separately)}}.
mes.faltaConferir: {count, plural, one {# employee still to review} other {# employees still to review}} before closing.
mes.vazioDesc: Register CLT employees with a salary to calculate payroll.
mes.confirmarFechar: Close the {comp} payroll? It gets locked, the month's cost starts using these figures and the bills below are created in Accounts payable.
mes.contasGeradas: Set the due date for each bill:
mes.fecharNota: Employer social security is not calculated here; it's in the charges percentage of the management cost. Confirm amounts and deadlines with your accountant.
mes.reabrirNota: Only possible if the generated bills haven't been paid and the cost period is open.

lanc.nota: Monthly variables. Salary comes from the record; commission and bonus come from Commissions and Monthly cost.
lanc.semManuais: Create "manual" items under Tables & parameters to enter other lines.

eventos.nota: Each event is a separate step: calculate, adjust the items, do the (mandatory) manual review and only then close. Closing creates the bills.
eventos.sugerirNota: The system suggests the items and the INSS, IRRF and FGTS incidence; review each line before approving.
eventos.fecharNota: Set the due date for the bills that will be created in Accounts payable. Management cost does not receive these amounts again: vacation and 13th are already accrued monthly.

rubricas.nota: Earnings and deductions of the payroll, with INSS, IRRF and FGTS incidence. Each system type uses one active item; extra lines use the "manual" type.
rubricas.vazio: No items. Load the defaults or create your own.
rubricas.incidenciaNota: On a deduction, the tick means it reduces the base (e.g. absences).

parametros.nota: Nothing is pre-filled: enter the values per the law and your company's rules. A blank parameter blocks the calculation that depends on it.

tabelas.nota: Editable, with effective date and history. The system ships no official values: enter the tables in force (you or your accountant are responsible for them). Changing a table doesn't change closed payrolls.
tabelas.vazio: Without a table the tax isn't calculated and the payroll can't be closed.
tabelas.aviso: Fill in with the official values in force and confirm with your accountant before using them in payroll.
tabelas.notaInss: Progressive INSS: each rate applies only to the part of the base inside the bracket; the ceiling is the limit of the last bracket.
tabelas.notaIrrf: IRRF: base × rate − amount to deduct. The last bracket has no limit (leave it blank).
tabelas.simplificadoHint: 0 = don't use. If set, the more favourable calculation applies.

pin.subtitulo: Every HR action requires your 4-digit PIN.
